optimizedContext.value:
# GetProjectContext

## Rules
- `execute(input: GetProjectContextInput)`: optional `contextMode` (`'list'|'summary'|'full'|'hybrid'`), `llmOptimizedContext`, `followDeps`, `depth`, `sections` (`ReadonlyArray<SpecSection>`). MUST NOT include `config`.
- Returns `GetProjectContextResult`: `contextEntries`, `specs` (`ContextSpecEntry[]`, all `source: 'includePattern'`), `warnings`. Mode from `config.contextMode`; `hybrid`≡`full` (no change specs). Full mode = structured metadata/extraction, NOT raw markdown.
- Resolve schema via `SchemaProvider.get()` first; `SchemaNotFoundError`/`SchemaValidationError` propagate.
- Render `config.context` in order before specs: `instruction` → `**Source: instruction**`; `file` via `FileReader` → `**Source: <path>**` (headings +1); missing file → `missing-file` warning + skip.
- Apply project `contextIncludeSpecs` then `contextExcludeSpecs` across all workspaces via same `listMatchingSpecs` as `CompileContext` (all workspaces active).
- MUST NOT apply workspace-level context patterns.
- `followDeps: true`: traverse `dependsOn` via `GetSpecMetadata.execute` (self-healing) then schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn` fallback; shared extractor-transform registry; respect `depth`; fail if transforms cannot normalize; NEVER read `spec-lock.json` directly.
- Render: `list` = no GetSpecMetadata; `summary` = title+description; `full`/`hybrid` = sections — default Description+Rules+Constraints when `sections` absent/empty. Forward GetSpecMetadata warnings.
- Fallback when no projection: `missing-metadata` warning → live extraction → empty heading if no declarations; fail on transform failure.
- Deps: `listWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider`, `files`, `getMetadata`, `parsers`, `defaultConfig` (`CompileContextConfig`). Shallow-merge `defaultConfig` with runtime overrides at execute start.
- `llmOptimizedContext` on → prefer fresh cached optimized project context from `core:project-metadata`; off → never return cache as primary. Stale/empty → warn + standard compile; warning MUST include "Launch specd-project-context-optimizer agent to generate it".
- Config factory: `resolveGetProjectContextDeps(resolver)` → `createGetProjectContext(deps)`; deps include hasher, extractorTransforms, workspaceRoutes, defaultConfig — no inline fs wiring.

## Constraints
- No change context — all workspaces active.
- Workspace-level patterns never applied.
- Specs matched by multiple includes appear once.
- Context entries before spec content.
- Async: `Promise<GetProjectContextResult>`.
- Same formatting as `CompileContext`.
- `dependsOn` traversal only when `followDeps: true`.
